verified_context: The author wants primary groups as visible actions and secondary groups as revealable actions, standardized by compiler/UI rather than generated ad-hoc HTML.

Existing form lowering supports a named operation independently of a record; edit/delete/row action lowering requires the existing stored row. Card/view layouts are being added. Page rendering owns its header and receives child results individually. Modal/drawer uses slots and collection renderers have different row structures.

Including page and form enables a normal visible Create opener using current protected form APIs, with extra page-header layout and checks. Card/view-only qualifies record actions but excludes page-level Create. Dialogs and collections need further decisions about placement.

host_set.instructions: Select the clearest bounded set of containers and controls for this new action-priority syntax.

criteria.A: Limit admission to card/view record controls and reject page, panel and collection placement for now.
criteria.B: Admit page/card/view with form as well as existing record controls, keeping every existing binding and row requirement; qualify page/card heading defaults and leave slots/collections out.
criteria.C: Admit all listed page/card/view/dialog/drawer/collection surfaces and implement their distinct action regions in this change.
